links.comparator_used: Standalone LLM without knowledge graph retrieval
links.outcome: Answer accuracy score on 80 standardized questions (3 expert raters)
links.quote: Across 80 paired questions, KG-LLM achieved higher accuracy scores than the standalone LLM (mean 3.05, SD 1.88 vs mean 2.02, SD 1.54; Holm-adjusted P<.001) and higher completeness scores (mean 3.11, SD 1.84 vs mean 2.42, SD 1.62; adjusted P=.002).

design_hint: retrieval grounding with knowledge graph added to LLM
